schema: CREATE TABLE Departments (department_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, department_name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER, location TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (manager_id) REFERENCES Employees(employee_id)); CREATE TABLE Employees (employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT, email TEXT, phone TEXT, hire_date DATE, job_id TEXT, salary DECIMAL, commission_pct DECIMAL, manager_id INTEGER, department_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES Jobs(job_id)); CREATE TABLE Jobs (job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_title TEXT, min_salary DECIMAL, max_salary DECIMAL); CREATE TABLE JobHistory (employee_id INTEGER, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, job_id TEXT, department_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES Employees(employee_id), FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES Jobs(job_id), FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES Departments(department_id));
